<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="abyssal-demons" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Abyssal Demons</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Abyssal demons offer high experience rates while being completely afk. Being that they don't deal much damage, they're a great option for lower level players.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="stats"><nowiki>Stats</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> level: 85</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> XP per kill: 277.2</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Optimal kills per hour: ~2400 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, ~3075 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, ~2310 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, ‎ ‎~ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Optimal </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> XP per hour: ~665k </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, ~852k </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, ~640k </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, ~ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="desirable-drops"><ins><nowiki>Desirable drops</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Abyssal Demons drop the Abyssal whip </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/860891494805536769.png?v=1" alt="abyssalwhip" title="abyssalwhip" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, wand </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409588590805043.png?v=1" alt="abyssalwand" title="abyssalwand" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and orb </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/860891495041073152.png?v=1" alt="abyssalorb" title="abyssalorb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> which are required for the Slayer Log. They also drop alchables and hard clues at a decent rate.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If killed in the Wilderness, they can also drop </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006481325076787240.png?v=1" alt="revenantdropenhancer" title="revenantdropenhancer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> which can be helpful for Ultimate Slayer hunters.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="useful-items"><nowiki>Useful Items</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>Owning the following increases the efficiency of your sessions, but is by no means mandatory.
</nowiki></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><div><div><u><nowiki>Items</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Portable_obelisk <nowiki>Portable obelisk</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137735861937655900.png?v=1" alt="portableobelisk" title="portableobelisk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Obelisk_shard <nowiki>Obelisk shard</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • Allows for an easy teleport to the lvl 18 wilderness obelisk.
⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Demon_horn_necklace <nowiki>Demon horn necklace</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975765831248130079.png?v=1" alt="demonhornnecklace" title="demonhornnecklace" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Attuned_ectoplasmator <nowiki>Attuned Ectoplasmator</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023152065431744542.png?v=1" alt="ectoplasmator" title="ectoplasmator" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Helps sustain your prayer.
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Other</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Armour perked with </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Demon_Slayer_(perk) <nowiki>Demon Slayer</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502842653900818.png?v=1" alt="demonslayerperk" title="demonslayerperk" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • +7% damage against demons.
⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Infernal_Puzzle_Box <nowiki>Infernal Puzzle Box (tier 6)</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189299681607800.png?v=1" alt="infernalpuzzlebox" title="infernalpuzzlebox" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • 14% damage reduction and 9% damage increase whilst in the Wilderness.
        ⬩ This effect scales with the tier of your puzzle box.
    • Tier 6 allows you to put it in your tool belt.
⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Artisans'_Workshop_Reward_Shop <nowiki>Restocking Cannon Ability</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1" alt="cannon" title="cannon" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Allows </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1" alt="cannon" title="cannon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> restocking without user input.
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="location-and-how-to-get-there"><ins><nowiki>Location and How to Get there</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>The best spot for abyssal demons is located at the level 18 Wilderness obelisk (Graveyard of Shadows). The fastest way to reach the location is using the portable obelisk or an obelisk shard.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Level 18 Wilderness</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/MtWr7YkgwP.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
⬥ Place </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1" alt="cannon" title="cannon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> on yellow tile as shown below (2E of stump NE of obelisk) and stand on red tile (2N and 2W of stump SE of obelisk).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If your character gets walked off the marked tile, step back on it, and click the nearest demon.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="method-afk-all-styles"><ins><nowiki>Method - AFK (All styles)</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Upkeep Elder Overload </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289831800882.png?v=1" alt="elderovl" title="elderovl" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and Weapon Poison +++ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1" alt="weppoison" title="weppoison" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/926021352626982942.png?v=1" alt="zealots" title="zealots" kind="icon" /><nowiki> pray </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1285372688457797672.png?v=1" alt="eclipsedsoul" title="eclipsedsoul" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1344313898068738151.png?v=1" alt="ultimatestrength" title="ultimatestrength" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1344313902808174712.png?v=1" alt="overpoweringforce" title="overpoweringforce" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1344313901189431296.png?v=1" alt="overcharge" title="overcharge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137941007795757117.png?v=1" alt="accelerateddecay" title="accelerateddecay" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Sustain </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1" alt="prayer" title="prayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975765831248130079.png?v=1" alt="demonhornnecklace" title="demonhornnecklace" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023152065431744542.png?v=1" alt="ectoplasmator" title="ectoplasmator" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1" alt="powderofpenance" title="powderofpenance" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069332584693810.png?v=1" alt="penanceaspect" title="penanceaspect" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Bring </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489526534154.png?v=1" alt="sbsstandards" title="sbsstandards" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069332584693810.png?v=1" alt="penanceaspect" title="penanceaspect" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and Magic </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /></p>
